fato_historico: 2017: A flood a few miles outside of Athens results in the death of 25 people.
energia_do_dia: Today may bring a wave of profound empathy as the cosmos encourages you to honor the flow of life's unpredictable waters. Just as nature reminds us to cherish every drop, consider how your resilience turns challenges into wisdom. It is a good time to reach out to loved ones and share the warmth of your radiant heart.
frase_do_dia: Find the golden light even in the midst of the deepest ocean currents.
significado_numero: A powerful reminder to value the precious bonds we hold dear today.
conselho: Nurture your connections and cherish the safety of your home and loved ones.
